scope: Lossless storage conversion of 156 previously audited local recordings from three completed historical studies, retaining all successes and failures. Every uncompressed local source matches its original audit, and every archive is streamed through a complete decompression/hash check before removing its raw local duplicate. No remote file, current finish-study recording, scalar evidence, video, model, benchmark control or job is changed. Native originals are not rehashed during this local-only operation.
